blind.B1: Yes. Abstract: LLE/OH/YE men, vastus lateralis biopsies pre and 4 h after 3x10 knee extensions at 70% 1-RM. Exercise factor = time.point (PRE vs POST); the training-state/age groups are a cohort factor, not the acute exercise. Series metadata: 81 samples, fiber FAST/SLOW x group LLE/YE/OH x PRE/POST (OH has POST only: 18 samples).
blind.B2: Abstract only: POST vs PRE exercise response in fast fibers and in slow fibers, separately per cohort (LLE n=8, OH n=9, YE n=8). Fast responded more than slow; slow responded only in LLE. Per-comparison sample numbers are not in the abstract; metadata allow 8 pairs per fiber x cohort (YE SLOW PRE short by one).
blind.B3: Yes. Each man gives PRE and POST and both fiber types. characteristics_ch1.4.subject.id restarts at 1 in every cohort, so the unit is group+subject id (title/description key; no duplicates within a level, 80/81 linked). Numeric IDs must be categories.
blind.B4: Abstract does not say. Per-fiber, per-cohort comparisons suggest stratum-wise fits, but this is not stated (abstract only).
blind.B5: Abstract states only 'P < 0.05'; no FDR/fold-change rule or DEG counts are reported in the abstract.

checks.evidence: Abstract: pre/4 h post resistance exercise; metadata title field carries PRE/POST. Series run for exercise question.

Four strata (FAST/SLOW x LLE/YE) with PRE and POST, n=8 pairs, SLOW YE 7 pairs (YE_5 SLOW PRE absent in metadata, named). OH has no PRE in this series (metadata: all OH are POST), so OH contrasts reported not estimable; exclusion reason stated.
design: control PRE, treatment POST for all contrasts; outputs DEG_results_POST_vs_PRE.
formula ~ subj + time with subj = <grp>_<id> as categorical (design_check full rank, 26 columns); the cohort-restarting id was correctly prefixed with group.
Paper (abstract) silent; strata fitted separately, joint alternative recorded as rejected (changes estimand). Open policy question only.
No batch/lane info; all male; sex check no_markers (human gene IDs) but one sex only. OH PRE processed in a different series, so merging was rejected to avoid batch confound.
featureCounts -M --fraction, integer_fraction 0.875, rounded and run with DESeq2; deviation recorded.
Abstract gives no rule; padj<0.05 recorded as workflow_default with raw P<0.05 audit counts; not claimed as paper rule.
HANDBACK states comparison is qualitative against the abstract only; no paper counts claimed.
OH contrasts not run because the series has no OH PRE samples (verified: all 18 OH samples are POST in metadata); stated source of PRE (GSE130977) cannot be checked from the files here.

human_items: Joint vs stratum-wise fit is open when the paper is silent; full text would settle it.
OH exercise response (paper's stress signature in fast fibers) needs GSE130977 OH PRE; optionally a labelled sensitivity run, with batch caveat.
Paper DEG rule and counts need the full text; the run is a declared deviation.
summary: 本案例判定通过：运动因素（PRE 与 POST 4 小时）、配对单位（组别加受试者编号）、方向（POST 对 PRE）和模型（~subj + time，按纤维类型与队列分层）均与摘要相符。OH 组在本系列中无 PRE 样本，因此未做对比并已如实记录。论文的方法、阈值和 DEG 数量需全文才能核对，已作为人工事项列出。
